takeaway: When a PR needs one, it ships with a short video that shows how it works.

doc.subtitle: A video for every PR that needs one

shots.caption: A big PR is pages of text. Reviewers run it to get it.
Not every PR. Only the ones people need to see.
Film the change running, cut it into a short video.
Like this: a few sheets, one line each.
It lands on the PR, so reviewers see it work first.
